## 2. §3 Benchmark: the label check

*Found once in `content.tex`.*

**Current:**

```latex
One partially independent reviewer, shown only the query text, re-labeled a
stratified sample of 14 AI-authored queries: Cohen's $\kappa=0.63$ \citep{cohen1960coefficient} (post hoc bootstrap
95\% interval [0.39, 1.00]), below our 0.7 target. The reviewer agreed with all 8 out-of-scope labels (exact 95\%
interval for the agreement rate [63, 100]\%; 7 everyday requests and one far-from-corpus computing task, none a
terminal task) and disagreed on 3 of 6 ambiguous ones. A two-annotator study with a written codebook is under way.
```

**Proposed:**

```latex
Two annotators, [G0: write "working independently" only if both confirmed it] from a written codebook and shown only the query text, re-labeled the AI-authored queries and 20 controls: Cohen's $\kappa=0.98$ \citep{cohen1960coefficient} (95\% bootstrap interval [0.94, 1.00], 78 items, 98.7\% agreement), above our pre-declared 0.7 target; both annotators kept the original label for 35 of 35 out-of-scope queries, meeting both pre-declared criteria; no third reader was available, so disputed items were excluded. No label changed. An earlier check by one partially independent reviewer ($n=14$) gave $\kappa=0.63$.
```

```js
// two-annotator label study (research/results/annotation/annotation_results.json)
{ const A = require(rel('research/results/annotation/annotation_results.json'));
  check('kappa', A.primary.kappa, 0.98); check('kappa lo', A.primary.ci95[0], 0.94); check('kappa hi', A.primary.ci95[1], 1.00);

  check('OOD kept', A.outcomes_targets.ood_confirmation.both_agree_with_original, 35); check('OOD n', A.outcomes_targets.ood_confirmation.n, 35); }
```
